params._comment: CUT-INTRO reshoot: slow orbital drift with foreground silhouette framing. The old ~270-degree lap is now a ~175-degree drift (~0.6 deg/tick) that starts LOW and far (48 out, 14 below the altar — the island reads as a black cutout against the post-burst sky) and eases in to a ~32-block closest pass: FloatingDecor's rubble ring (r 11-23) sits between camera and island there, so fragments cross the frame as foreground silhouettes with real parallax. Gentle counter-rolls (max 1.5) keep the drift organic; FOV breathes 60->55->58 (tightest at the closest pass). The lookAt climbs -2 -> +4 so the final frames tilt up the island flank toward the crown — handing composition to SUNRISE. Caption retimed 0.1->0.12 to let the silhouette read first; settle shake softened to a low rumble (0.12, freq 1.2). Keyframes are offsets from the play anchor (altar position).
params._doc: Per-keyframe 'fov' (degrees, default 70) is smoothly lerped along the flight by CameraDirector.onComputeFov and eases back into the player's own FOV at the end. Top-level 'showOwnBody' (default false) keeps the watcher's own player model visible — author true only for shots that deliberately frame the watcher.
